versions.changelog:
- Initial release of opc-roadshow-management skill, designed for systematic quarterly project roadshow management for OPC mentors.
- Supports complete workflow: track selection, project screening, roadshow scheduling, AI-driven meeting records, investor Q&A analysis, and precise matching with investment institutions.
- Provides standardized templates and SOPs for project selection, meeting minutes, and decision-making processes.
- Integrates automated data analysis for investor feedback, project tracking, and quarterly review.
- Includes detailed supporting documents and modular references for easy deployment and process optimization.
